page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a catchword at the bottom right. No running head. Page number at the top left. No marginal notes; show-through and edge marks at the right edge are left out.

main_text.p: stantinopolitanæ, in vita sancti Nicephori Patriarchæ CP. de matre eiusdem Eudocia. Historiam Politicam Græcam apud Crusium, de Gennadio Patriarcha. Manuelem Calecam, Oratione de sancto Stephano Protomartyre. Philotheũ Patriarcham CP. cognomēto Coccinum, Oratione de sancto Demetrio Martyre. Alexandrum Monachum, Oratione in sanctum Barnabam Apostolum. Nicephorum Gregoram, Historiæ lib. 18., & lib. 29. in vita sancti Michaelis Syncelli, & in Martyrio sancti Quadrati. Ioannem Argyropulum, Orationeconsolatoria ad Constantinum Imperatorem, in morte fratris eius Ioannis Palæologi Imperatoris. Theodulum Magistrum Thessalonicensem Oratione in S. Ioannem Baptistam. Manuelem Palæologum Imperatorem, Laudatione in Gabrielem Episcopum Thessalonicensem, Laudatione in sanctam Euphemiam Martyrem, Laudatione in sanctos Patres nostros, & Universales Doctores, qui in septem sanctis, & univer-salibus Synodis interfuerunt, Laudatione in Dauidem Thessalonicensem Episcopum, Oratione Consolatoria in mortem fratris Ioannis. Michaelem Apostolium, in Epicedio Galateni, In Epitaphio Manuelis Calotarae, & Epistola ad Petrum Calergem.

page.notes: The first line is a fragment of a word cut off at the top ("stantinopolitanæ"), so it is kept as a fragment with cont="true". Long s is read as plain s throughout (printed as f in places, e.g. "stantinopolitanæ", "falibus", "Thessalonicensem"). "Vniuersales" and "vniuer-" are given as Universales and univer- under the u/v rule. The line "Orationeconsolatoria" is printed without a space and is kept as printed. The catchword "Ni-" is a hyphenated word at the line end and is kept only in the catchword.
